answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round. What survives to the beacon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
